profile.headline: Senior Software  Engineer at Charter Communications
profile.summary:
- Extensive Database Experience – working with relational databases (MS SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL) and B-Tree file storage experience.  Database schema design for application support.
 - Web-based and Network Database Development – ODBC/JDBC using ASP.NET and MS SQL Server, PHP and MySQL (LAMP) as well as Perl, Java/Tomcat and various scripting languages as required.
 - Document Encoding and conversion – worked extensively with both public (SOAP, HTML, Subex Diamond) and customer-designed XML, also customer-specified structured data files as input materials.
 - Application Development – C/C++/C#, Java, Perl.   
 - Telecommunication Data Integrity Management (DIM) – experience implementing a DIM solution as part of the implementation team for the Subex ROC Data Integrity Management application.
 - Communication Service Provider (CSP) settlements – experience implementing the  Subex ROC cost-assurance product.
 - Telecom Revenue Assurance – experience implementing Subex ROCware, a data-based revenue assurance product that allows telecom operators to identify and assess revenue loss.

positions.title: Senior Software  Engineer
positions.description:
2018 - current:  Metadata Services Test and Automation
Charter's Metadata Services team builds, maintains and supports a set of products that import data associated with our video assets (images, reviews, actor biographies), standardizes it, and makes it available for internal use.
- Maintain test environments and support automated testing for multiple products running both on internal VMs and AWS systems.
- Pair one-on-one with developers to create tests for new features.
- As a product moved to AWS, worked with DevOps to move the accompanying test-suite to AWS.

2011 - 2018:  Test Lead ODN (OCAP Digital Navigator) Automated Testing
- Managed test suites and development for RTI (Remote Test Integration) an in-house, automated test system designed to run tests and record and report test results across multiple set-top boxes in different head-end environments.
- Orchestrated the move from PostgreSQL to Oracle SQL as the supporting database in RTI reporting.  This included: database redesign to a modified star schema to address sizing issues, creating a functional proof-of-concept, writing post-transfer validation tests and working across multiple teams to support implementation.

positions.title: Implementation Consultant
positions.description:
- Worked on-site at Level3 with the Subex team implementing the current contract to provide Data Integrity Management.  In my role I worked in ROCware with the result data to implement the business rules that create the investigation cases, dashboards and reporting.
- Worked with a team to develop a settlement billing for content partners for a LEC.  I designed and implemented the process for customized reporting to Accounts Receivable and Finance working with the customer from their internal requirements.
- Participated as a team member in a number of custom ROC Revenue Assurance implementations for telecom customers across a mixture of services—Wireless, POTS, Cable and partnered content—across a number of areas such as customer billing, fullfillment, service at switch level and content settlement.  
- On many Subex telecom implementations provided custom processing for data from multiple sources in multiple formats to present a clear picture for analysis.

positions.title: Independent Consultant – database design, application development and consulting
positions.description: Designed, implemented and supported web-based online registration database for Rocky Mountain division of SCCA using PHP and MySQL (LAMP).  The solution is still in use.

positions.title: Lead Software Designer/Implementor and Project Leader
positions.description:
- Acted as a consultant for a web/phone application supporting pilots.  The implementation involved C#/Tomcat/Oracle with presentation in ASP.NET and WAP.
- Primary developer for ¶ublisher's ¶aradise™ and Card.  These proprietary software applications published documents on CD-ROM using a small-footprint B-Tree data scheme.  Original development was in C/C++; also ported components to Java and C# for web-enabled components. 
Implemented an ODBC interface for B-Tree data storage.
- Extensive data conversion experience using SunOS/UNIX/DOS scripting.
